newsitem.title: USA: Piercing Pagoda to offer 1.55 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Piercing Pagoda to offer 1.55 mln shrs.

text.p: Piercing Pagoda Inc said Wednesday it plans a public offering of 1.55 million shares at 24-7/8 per share.
The company said 650,000 shares are being offered by the company and 900,000 are being offered by stockholders.
The offering is being managed by an underwriting group led by Robertson, Stephens & Co LLC, Wheat First Butcher Singer, Furman Selz and Parker/Hunter Inc, the company said.
An additional 97,500 shares may be sold by the company and an additional 135,000 shares may be sold by the stockholders under an over-allotment option granted to the underwriters, the company said.
